<h2>Make Leave-One-Location-Out Assignments</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Assigns each complete sampling location to its own held-out fold using the
shared cross-validation assignment schema.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>make_leave_one_location_out_assignments(data_locations = NULL, repeat_id = 1L)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_locations">data_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Location table returned by [make_cross_validation_location_table()] with
'location_id', 'n_samples', and 'row_indices' columns.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="repeat_id">repeat_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single positive integer identifying the assignment repeat. Defaults to
'1L'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tibble with 'repeat_id', 'fold_id', 'location_id', 'grid_cell_id',
'n_samples', and 'row_indices'. 'grid_cell_id' is 'NA' because spatial-grid
stratification is not applicable to leave-one-location-out assignment.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_locations &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    location_id = c("core_a", "core_b"),
    n_samples = c(2L, 1L),
    row_indices = list(c(1L, 2L), 3L)
  )
make_leave_one_location_out_assignments(data_locations)
</code></pre>

</main>
